blakeyssss: The draft reached T-F13 on Day 9. Albin Blakeyssss was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Albin Blakeyssss reached up to fix a sandbag at T-F13 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Teodor Rozenband of the Concord (@oran__rozenband). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Albin Blakeyssss helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
carcinogeneticist24: The new field cook gave his name as Emil Carcinogenet. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Emil Carcinogenet helped stack spare sandbags at T-F7. Nobody asked when they would be needed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Carcinogenet. Emil Carcinogenet read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
chaser143: At the depot, Silas Chaser had practised answering to his name. At Q-F17, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-F17. Silas Chaser has learned to walk bent double.
collinjsampson: Arno Collinjsamps came up the line with a pressed cornflower and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
davidsonmarshall: Rafael Davidsonmars arrived on Day 4 as a replacement. The men in R-F2 had been fighting for 3 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world. Orders assigned Rafael Davidsonmars to work as a sniper. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

At the Hanging Bridge, Rafael Davidsonmars of the Concord and Cyril "Tin" Latsch of the Hegemony spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning. A letter from home reached Rafael Davidsonmars before dusk. Rafael Davidsonmars read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Rafael Davidsonmars tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F2 is up. Rafael Davidsonmars had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Gustav "Brick" Floooring crossed it, Rafael Davidsonmars fired. Gustav "Brick" Floooring was grazed. A letter from home reached Rafael Davidsonmars before dusk. Rafael Davidsonmars read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 is lost. Rafael Davidsonmars heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Rafael Davidsonmars put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Rafael Davidsonmars heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot.
On sentry duty Rafael Davidsonmars watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.

Rafael Davidsonmars let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Gustav "Brick" Floooring was grazed. Rafael Davidsonmars lay behind a dead tree trunk at R-F2 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Cyril "Tin" Latsch was gravely wounded.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F2. Rafael Davidsonmars was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Isidor "Tin" Brayden of the Hegemony (@brayden27727).
Henrik Davidsonmars asked about Rafael Davidsonmars on arriving at R-F2. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
dino_ramaci: Cyril Ramaci came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Cyril Ramaci watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper. A letter from home found Cyril Ramaci before the night shift. Cyril Ramaci folded it small and kept it close.
ferg_haggis: By the time Oskar Haggis reached R-R7, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Oskar Haggis counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Felix Lowelleast was grazed. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Oskar Haggis wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
gabo_kream99: Bram "Rabbit" Kream, a lamplighter from Greyhallow, was sent forward on Day 8 to fill a gap in R-S4. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Bram "Rabbit" Kream had orders to attack at dawn. He wrote back asking for artillery first. The orders were cancelled. Nobody knows which of his words did it.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Bram "Rabbit" Kream looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
gastongimenez___: Yann Gastongimene arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Yann Gastongimene did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
hunterplum: Silas "Bones" Hunterplum joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Silas "Bones" Hunterplum listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
jurassic_guy013: Tobias Guy, a brewer from Brennmoor, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in R-C8. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Tobias Guy stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
kjoj_iv: Karel "Tin" Kjoj walked into R-R3 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Karel "Tin" Kjoj wrote to a sweetheart who has stopped writing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
